_note: The facts about the site that are not facts about the program. Everything a page needs from here it takes through a {{token}}, so each of these appears once.
_languages: The first is the default and lives at the root. The others live under /{code}/.
_theme_color: The window's own background, src/Bws.Gui/Themes - the colour a browser paints its chrome with on a phone.

social_image.alt: Better Windows Services - search your Windows services, preview every change, and see what drifted since yesterday

_search_console_token: Google Search Console verification. Empty means no tag is written at all, which is right for a site nobody has claimed.
_link_hosts: Every host a link on this site may point at. The site loads nothing from anywhere else and the build refuses an src to any of these; for an href, a host not on this list is a typo in a domain.
